meeting.intent: Schedule an alignment meeting with the Product team next Wed afternoon, and book a room with a whiteboard.

meeting.future_task1: Coordinated calendars of 5 team members (all free at 14:00)
meeting.future_task2: Called Admin API to book 'Innovation Space A'
meeting.future_task3: Drafted and sent calendar invites, CC'd management

finance.intent: Reimburse my flights and taxi fares from last week's Beijing trip.
finance.past_desc: Find template -> Fill complex codes -> Attach receipts -> Rejected and resubmitted.
finance.future_task1: Extracted amounts and itinerary from receipts
finance.future_task3: Generated voucher and routed to manager for 1-click approval

hr.intent: New hire Alice joins the Design team tomorrow. Set up her environment.
hr.past_desc: HR profiles -> IT tickets for email -> Manually assign seats in various tools.

data.intent: Summarize this month's CAC by channel, compile a brief, and send to execs.
data.past_desc: Export CSVs -> Merge in Excel -> Create charts -> Paste to PPT and email.
data.future_task1: Queried data across 3 core business systems
